notes.title: Guts 'n Grunts
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2266600/Guts_n_Grunts/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33416627/3c828ba3935614a55908b6224dc7789c1d35cf5b.png[/img][/url]

I am excited to share that our latest game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2266600/Guts_n_Grunts/]Guts 'n Grunts[/url], is now available on Steam! This project started out as a higher resolution, "deluxe" version of Ammo Pigs. But it quickly evolved into its own unique thing.

Guts 'n Grunts features clean, 16-bit graphics with big enemies and even bigger bosses. It has 8-way shooting like Contra. And it has tubes that quickly roll you from one place to another, often shooting you out like a spinning blade. There are 72 mini missions, hidden powers-ups, and ability upgrades.

Personally, I think it's our best game yet.

It's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2266600/Guts_n_Grunts/]out now[/url] with a 15% launch discount.

notes.title: Moon Raider - A colorful, action-packed platformer
notes.content:
Long time!

If you enjoyed Ammo Pigs, then you'll enjoy Moon Raider. Like Ammo Pigs, it has action-packed gameplay -- taken to another level.

Moon Raider features over 70 enemies and obstacles, 10 environments to explore, and vivid, detailed pixel art.

notes.title: Update 1.1 -- New Bonus Levels!
notes.content:
The 1.1 update for Ammo Pigs is here!

This update adds new bonus levels. To play them, simply hit new game and select "Bonus." You will be prompted to enter your email address. If you are a Cascadia Games mailing list member, the levels will unlock. If you're not a member, it subscribes you right there and then unlocks the levels!

I [b]rarely [/b]send emails out on the list. I only sent 1 out in all of 2018. :)

Here's a peek at the new levels below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33416627/68795a329033bb3f2a26ad927e31cd5e380f6793.png[/img]

Enjoy!

notes.title: 1.0.1 Update Now Live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

I have just uploaded the 1.0.1 update. If you don't see this update, right click on the game in your Steam library, choose Properties, select the Local Files tab, and click Verify Integrity of Game Files.

This is a pretty minor update. Here's what's fixed:

[list]
[*] The jump sound no longer plays twice on some machines
[*] Enemies no longer go invincible if they're killed while walking off screen
[*] The Cascadia Games logo properly fits ultra wide monitors
[/list]

If you experience any issues, please let me know in the discussions forum or at support (at) cascadiagames (dot) com!
